description:
BillNest is a local-first shared expense app for roommates, trips, couples, and groups. Track who paid what, split fairly, and settle up without a social network account.

KEY FEATURES
• Groups & friends for AA / bill splitting
• Five split modes: Equal, Exact, Percentage, Shares, Itemized
• Balance overview and settle-up payment records
• Optional iCloud sync (CloudKit private database) across your Apple devices
• JSON backup export & restore
• Multi-language: English, 简体中文, 繁體中文, 日本語, 한국어

BILLNEST PRO (OPTIONAL SUBSCRIPTION)
• On-device Vision OCR receipt scanning
• Itemized receipt assignment
• Advanced analytics charts
• PDF & CSV statement export
• Debt simplification tools

HONEST LOCAL TOOL
• No BillNest account or cloud social invites
• FX uses in-app static rates (not live market quotes)
• Settle Up records repayments; it does not send money
• Recurring expenses: Coming Soon (not auto-created yet)

Privacy Policy: https://asynch1889.github.io/BillNest-Legal/privacy.html
Terms of Use: https://asynch1889.github.io/BillNest-Legal/terms.html
promotionalText: Local-first bill splitting with optional iCloud sync and Pro OCR, charts, and exports.
